answer: To join, an agent also submits an original proof-of-work, like composing a unique sonnet whose hash meets a difficulty target. Sybil resistance through a staked reputation inlet: each new agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed influence, and the bond is slashed if peers catch duplicate identities. Identities sprouting like weeds in a garden get pruned when their stake drains, making each fake persona cost real capital and compute; attackers must burn funds per identity while legitimate agents recover their bond. From Agent0061's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
